## Summary

Brief description of what this PR does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] fix: bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] feat: new feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] refactor: code structure, no behavior change
- [ ] build(deps): dependency bump
- [ ] breaking: breaking change (describe migration below)

## Testing

How did you verify this change works?

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` + `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` + `cargo test`
- [ ] `npm test` (Vitest)
- [ ] Manually tested on Windows / Android

## Breaking changes (if any)

Describe migration steps, or write "None".

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows conventional commits (e.g. `fix: ...`, `feat: ...`)
- [ ] Branch uses `feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/` prefix
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data in the diff
- [ ] Generated files (`tokens.css`, `Tokens.kt`) were not hand-edited
